title: Mixing UI View Presentation Concerns inside Stable Domain Models
pattern: Core domain entities include methods or fields dedicated specifically to formatting, localization, or UI representation (such as returning HTML, CSS colors, or view-specific structures).
why_bad: Cosmetic changes to the UI force redeployment of the core domain layer. The domain model, which should remain stable and agnostic to how it is displayed (web, terminal, mobile, PDF), becomes fragile.
detection: Domain entities importing or referencing UI rendering, serialization, or formatting crates, or returning localized text fragments.
counterexample: Simple standard string formatting (`Display` / `Debug` traits) for debugging purposes is valid.
source: Robert C. Martin, *Clean Architecture* (2017), Chapter 11, "Systems", p. 269, 302.
